text_to_speech: on the late one this saturday night join us i'm marlon hill and i'm running to be your next county commissioner for district 9. my wife carla and i have resided in our district for over 35 years our district has grown from a farming community to a dynamic multicultural region but our district has also been disconnected from the rest of the county as your commissioner we want to expand your transportation options keep our families safe and create an economy that works for all i'm marlon hill and on august 18th let's bring a new day to district 9.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: On the late one, this Saturday night, join us.
I'm Marlon Hill, and I'm running to be your next County Commissioner for District 9.
My wife, Carla and I have resided in our district for over 35 years.
Our district has grown from a farming community to a dynamic multicultural region.
But our district has also been disconnected from the rest of the county.
As your commissioner, you want to expand your transportation options,
be for families safe, and create an economy that works for all.
I'm Marlon Hill, and on August 18th, let's bring a new day to District 9.

MY GUEST: Marlon Hill, Candidate for the Miami-Dade County Commission, District 9.
